svg.aria-label: Shared court: plan and section bubble study
svg.title: Shared court: plan and section bubble study
svg.desc: Proposed bubble relationships, not measured plans. South pedestrian entrance and east ramp to underground parking are constant. Every option pairs a ground diagram with above-ground and B1 sectional relationships.

g.text: Nest rooms around a common outdoor space
N up · actual mapped plot outline; bubbles are not room footprints
C1 trace is on the common-brief locator; this approach is schematic.
South at left · north at right · schematic levels, not measured heights
B1 + four above-ground levels. Ramp, capacity, ground conditions and rules: VERIFY.
Upper galleries overlook the open court.
Shared circulation surrounds it, with quieter rooms behind.
Growing occupies part of an upper edge, beside support.
Both entrances reach the same welcome space.
From here, a public loop opens onto a shared court;
display, learning and cafe spaces address this centre.
Makes a shared centre easy to recognise and inhabit.
A large court may squeeze the small permitted floor plates.
South pedestrian door + east ramp to underground parking.
B1 → lift / stairs → shared welcome; east walk-in door retained.
Basement feasibility and how it is counted remain design checks.
SCHEMATIC / bubble size does not represent area. Outline is a mapped reference; no footprint or setback compliance is asserted.
